name: Pokémon Echo
storyline: Welcome to the Naisan Region: A vibrant land shaped by innovation, ancient mysteries, and hidden wonders. In Pokémon Echo, you join Professor Pallas as their assistant, exploring sprawling routes, forgotten temples, and long-lost settlements teeming with rare Pokémon. Rather than focusing on the Gym Challenge, your journey emphasizes archaeological discovery, solving puzzles in temple dungeons, connecting with locals, and piecing together Naisan’s hidden past.
summary: Pokémon Echo is an episodic, free fan-made Pokémon RPG set in the Naisan Region, focused on exploration and discovery. You play as Professor Pallas’s assistant, canvasing the vast, open region to uncover the region’s history through puzzles and overworld interactions. Experience a story-driven adventure with a double-battle emphasis and fully custom visuals. No copyright infringement intended.
